title: Construction Matrix
text: Creates Void Crystals at the spell impact, normally lasting twenty seconds. Enhancement strengthens them and raises blast resistance; each Delay doubles their lifetime, while Infusion makes them permanent. Use a staff to left-click them away.

On creatures, Construction locks movement and actions for 5 seconds, but has no effect on bosses. Delay doubles the duration and Enhancement adds crushing damage. Infusion encloses the creature in temporary Void Crystals, requiring free space around it.

The enclosing crystals' mining difficulty increases with the creature's health and armor. Before the lock ends, mine any one of them with a suitable pickaxe to kill the target; the tool's Fortune acts as Looting for drops. The remaining crystals disappear when the lock ends.
